Whosthere is a Go-based Local Area Network discovery tool that provides an interactive Terminal User Interface (TUI) for exploring network devices. It uses multiple unprivileged scanning techniques like mDNS, SSDP, and ARP cache analysis to identify devices and enriches this information with OUI lookups for manufacturer details.
